releaseNotes: Anime goes direct: watch anime through the new JustAnime source streamed straight to your device — sub and dub tracks with built-in subtitles, smart server ranking that picks the fastest working source, and automatic fallback when one fails. Player redesign: a new episode panel that jumps straight to the episode you're watching, a YouTube-style progress bar with tap-to-seek and precise drag scrubbing, a screen-fit setting, and cleaner controls in landscape. Fixes: the next episode now resumes at the right timestamp instead of the previous episode's end, seeking stays accurate, and sheets open and close with smooth animations.
